scoring_justification: Reaction energy is recomputed from agent's submitted formation energies; formation energies compared to paper gold because DFT total energies are not available to verifier. Recompute of the headline decomposition energy achieves T1.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported formation energies and decomposition reaction energy used as hidden gold comparison targets.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'formation energy of the Fe₂CrSi compound with L2₁ structure to be -0.93 eV/f.u. (-0.98 eV/f.u. for the A15 structure)', 'formation energy for the above reaction is -1.31 eV/f.u.', 'Thus, the system gains 0.38 eV/f.u. by decomposing Fe₂CrSi into Fe₃Si and Cr₃Si.' Fe₃Si formation energy derived as -1.12 eV/f.u. from reaction energy and given values, Cr₃Si -1.84 eV/f.u. from same source.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Quoted directly from paper sentences; Fe₃Si and Cr₃Si energies inferred from the published reaction energy and Fe₂CrSi energies.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported DFT formation energies and reaction energy, guaranteeing consistency with the paper's main claim.

outputs.description: Contains the formation energies of the four studied crystalline phases and the decomposition reaction energy, derived from DFT total energies. The checker compares these values against the paper-reported hidden gold within a hidden tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The reaction energy must be positive. The agent must compute the formation energies from their own DFT total energies; the checker will compare against the paper's reported values. Internal consistency is checked by recomputing the reaction energy from the submitted formation energies using the lower Fe2CrSi value.
